== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍兵員</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値＞2を持つ反乱軍と同じ位置カードに配備する場合、配備コストなし。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">コレリアン・コルベットの兵士、オルデラン出身のチャド・ヒルズ少尉は、打倒帝国に生涯を捧げた忠実なる反乱軍志願兵の代表的人物といえる。宇宙船内及び地上戦闘技術を持つ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rebel Trooper]].

'''Lore''' — Corellian Corvette soldier Ensign Chad Hilse, from Alderaan, is typical of the loyal Rebel volunteers who have given their lives to defeating the Empire. He has starship and ground combat skill.

'''Game text''' — If deployed to the same location card as a Rebel with ability > 2, there is no deploy cost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is 反乱軍兵員. Deploys at no cost to the same location card as a Rebel with ability > 2. English deploys free to the same site as one of your Rebels with ability > 2.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-rebeltrooper.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Trooper]].</ref>
